Massachusetts ranks #6 of 51 tracked states (90th percentile) with 798 verified live revenue-role openings across 158 employers. State-average hiring aggressiveness is 71/100 with a active tier skew (49% of roles).

The market tilts toward Adjacent Revenue Roles (22% of reqs) concentrated in Remote-first (88%). Boston: intellectual, collaborative, driven but measured. Strong professional development culture - companies invest in rep training. Diverse in universities; corporate culture is traditional-professional with startup pockets.

HubSpot, Drift, Klaviyo, Rapid7, LogMeIn/GoTo, Veeva - strong mid-market SaaS cluster.
